Assignment 1

This page presents my first data visualization assignment for DSC 402.

Chart 1: Coffee Production Over Time

This chart shows coffee production among major producing countries over time. I chose a line chart because it makes changes in production across the years easy to compare. The points and hover tooltips also make it possible to see the production value for a specific country and year.

Chart 2: Coffee Production Over Time

This chart uses a bar chart to show coffee production among major producing countries over time. I chose bars as a variation from the line chart because they make the amount of production for each year easier to compare directly.

Chart 3: Coffee Production by Country and Year

This chart uses a scatter plot to show coffee production by country and year. I chose a scatter plot as another variation because the individual points make it easier to see how production values are distributed across countries and years.

Chart 4: Coffee Production by Country

This chart uses a bar chart to compare coffee production across countries. I chose this variation to shift the focus from changes over time to differences between countries.
